units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣请花散里当玉鬘的继母，

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, asked Hanachirusato to serve as Tamakazura's stepmother,

units.source_text: 对她说道：“从前我有一个所爱之人，为了忧愤，隐居在荒僻的山乡了。

en.t: and said to her, "Long ago I had someone I loved, but out of grief and resentment she withdrew to a remote mountain village.

units.source_text: 我俩之间已经生了一个女孩。

en.t: A daughter had already been born between the two of us.

units.source_text: 多年来我悄悄地寻访她的下落，总是寻找不到。

en.t: For many years I quietly searched for her whereabouts, but I could never find her.

units.source_text: 其间这女孩已经成人，我此次无意中找到了。

en.t: In the meantime the girl had grown up, and this time I found her by chance.

units.source_text: 既然找到，我应该抚养她，因此叫她迁移来此。

en.t: Since I have found her, I ought to raise her, and so I have had her move here.

units.source_text: 她母亲已经死了。

en.t: Her mother has already died.

units.source_text: 你是夕雾中将的保护人，我正好援例，就请你同样地保护这女孩吧。

en.t: You are Lieutenant General Yugiri's guardian, so following that precedent, I ask you to protect this girl in the same way.

units.source_text: 她生长山乡，恐多鄙陋之相，凡事要你多多教导了。”

en.t: She grew up in a mountain village and may have many rustic ways, so please instruct her carefully in everything."

units.source_text: 花散里直率地说道：“原来有这样的一个人，我一点也不知道呢。

en.t: Hanachirusato said frankly, "So there was such a person; I knew nothing of it at all.

units.source_text: 明石小女公子一个人不免寂寞，如此甚好。”

en.t: The young lady of Akashi must be lonely by herself, so this is very good."

units.source_text: 源氏又说：“她母亲性情极好，你也是个好心人，所以我托你照顾她。”

en.t: Genji added, "Her mother had an excellent nature, and you too are a kindhearted person, so I entrust her care to you."

units.source_text: 花散里说：“我可照顾的人甚少，常感寂寞。

en.t: Hanachirusato said, "There are very few people I can look after, and I often feel lonely.

units.source_text: 如今多了一人，真乃可喜之事。”

en.t: Now that there will be one more, it is truly a happy thing."

units.source_text: 院内侍女等不知道这是源氏太政大臣的女儿，

en.t: The serving women in the residence did not know that this was the daughter of Genji, the Grand Minister,

units.source_text: 相与言道：“不知又找到了怎样的一个人。

en.t: and said to one another, "Who knows what sort of person he has found this time?

units.source_text: 倒像玩古董，真无聊啊！”

en.t: It is like amusing himself with antiques; how tedious!"

units.source_text: 玉鬘迁居时，大约用了三辆车子。

en.t: When Tamakazura moved residence, about three carriages were used.

units.source_text: 各人打扮等事，均由右近料理，所以都很像样，全无村俗之气。

en.t: Ukon attended to everyone's dress and arrangements, so they all looked quite proper and showed no trace of rusticity.

units.source_text: 源氏赏赐绫罗等物甚多。

en.t: Genji bestowed many gifts, including fine twills and gauzes.
